mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may lower seizure threshold, while bupropion inherently increases seizure risk; concurrent use increases convulsive risk and potential for cardiac arrhythmias from electrolyte imbalance.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly; ensure adequate potassium supplementation if needed; assess seizure risk factors and consider alternative diuretics or agents with less electrolyte depletion.
